correctness.rationale: The center-blue case reduces exactly to the path non-forcing characterization. With a white center, the first force must target the center; this is equivalent to an endpoint pair or three consecutive path vertices. Those triggers guarantee completion. The resulting binary-string complement is counted exactly, and exhaustive direct simulation through \(m=17\) matches every coefficient.
